expect_red: a node feature is bound through the edge to its joint's other node, at its own end; an edge feature is its whole edge; a node nothing ends on is bound nowhere

mutations.contract: A joint's node feature is read through the edge between it and the joint's other node, not whichever edge happens to touch it first.
mutations.note: The fixture's n_top has an unrelated edge listed first; taking the first touching edge colours and highlights the wrong binding.
